name: ble_lle_ch585
description: CH585 plaintext BLE register subset. No reset values or unsupported field meanings inferred. Not a CH582 register map.

registers.name: COMMAND
registers.description: Observed RX=1, TX=2, SHUT=8 command values; undocumented values excluded.

registers.name: CONFIG
registers.description: Bit 0 staged RX/TX chaining; upper halfword has a separate 16-bit setup write. Do not treat all fields as one atomic semantic unit.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Bit 0 RX complete, bit 1 TX complete, bit 2 RX-to-TX service, bit 3 TX-to-RX service, bit 17 capture. Capture-start acknowledgement is not RX completion.

registers.name: RX_TO_TX_TIMING
registers.description: CH585 LE1M timing offset 0x76; not a microsecond value.

registers.name: MODE
registers.description: Complete observed words idle=0x30000, calibration=0x30558, RX=0x30158, TX=0x30258. Individual mode bits not fully specified.

registers.name: COUNTDOWN
registers.description: LE1M TX: ((packet_bytes+2)*8+0xee)*2, packet includes two-byte header. RX capture: (maximum_payload_bytes+5)*16+0x3c. Transition reload=0x18e. No claim these clocks are microseconds.

registers.name: TX_BUFFER
registers.description: Aligned SRAM TX pointer; CH585 plain packet is contiguous header then payload, with tail cleared.

registers.name: RX_BUFFER
registers.description: Aligned SRAM RX pointer; capture complete and CRC status must be established before consuming packet.
